immutableRules.successSignalMustBe: ATH receipt by official BuybackBurn ATH wallet, then ATHBurnFinalized from ATH Master

evidenceRefs.athDeploymentManifest: required: ATH deployment manifest artifact path/hash
evidenceRefs.buybackBurnStateInitVector: required: BuybackBurn StateInit vector artifact path/hash
evidenceRefs.officialAthWalletDerivationVector: required: official BuybackBurn ATH wallet derivation vector path/hash
evidenceRefs.stonfiSdkOrApiTxParams: required: official @ston-fi/sdk/API tx params capture path/hash
evidenceRefs.liveQuote: required: quote source, block/seqno/timestamp, and output amount path/hash
evidenceRefs.codeHashProofs: required: router/pool/pTON code hash evidence path/hash
evidenceRefs.successExcessProof: required: successful swap evidence where excesses return to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.minOutFailureRefundProof: required: min_out failure evidence where refund returns to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.ptonRefundProof: required: pTON refund evidence where refund returns to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.bounceOrFailureBehaviorProof: required: documented router/pTON/pool bounce/failure behavior evidence

addresses.athMasterAddress: EQ... final Platho ATH master address
addresses.buybackBurnOfficialAthWalletAddress: EQ... official BuybackBurn ATH wallet address
addresses.stonfiRouterAddress: EQ... selected STON.fi v2.1 router address
addresses.stonfiPoolAddressTonAth: EQ... selected STON.fi TON/ATH pool address
addresses.stonfiPtonWalletAddress: EQ... pTON wallet / proxy address used by selected router route
addresses.askJettonWalletAddress: EQ... router-side ATH jetton wallet address used as ask_jetton_wallet_address

swap.queryId: uint64 decimal string from captured SDK/API tx params
swap.deadline: uint64 decimal string from captured SDK/API tx params
swap.quoteOutAtomicAth: live quote output in atomic ATH units
swap.dexMinOutAtomicAth: min_out used in captured SDK/API tx params
swap.buybackMinAthOutPer50TonAtomic: pinned circuit-breaker min ATH out for 50 TON

sdkTxParams.sdkVersion: 2.7.0 or exact official SDK/API version used
sdkTxParams.capturedAt: ISO timestamp / block / tx evidence reference
sdkTxParams.bodyBocBase64: base64 BOC of official SDK/API pTON TON-transfer tx body

evidenceRefs.sdkTxParams: required: file path / tx hash / capture id
evidenceRefs.successExcess: required: successful swap tx evidence where excesses return to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.minOutFailureRefund: required: failed min_out tx evidence where refund returns to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.ptonRefund: required: pTON refund evidence where refund returns to BuybackBurn
evidenceRefs.bounceOrFailureBehavior: required: router/pTON/pool bounce/failure behavior notes and tx evidence
